Reasonably Priced Good Japanese food in Saigon City
Jul 2026 • Couples
We have eaten here 5 times in last three years when we have visited Saigon city, the food has been very good and well priced on each occasion, whilst we are in Vietnam for around 10/12 week's each year we tend to try several cuisines and Japanese in a favourite, Chiyoda Sushi is probably our favourite Japanese restaurant in Vietnam for price/ quality, we have eaten in better more expensive restaurants. But as a good all over restaurant I recommend Chiyoda Sushi.

food poisoning
Jan 2026 • Couples
I had sushi here today with my wife and unfortunately developed a severe case of food poisoning afterwards. I became so ill that I almost had to rush to the hospital. This is absolutely unacceptable. If this had happened in Germany, I would have immediately reported it to the food safety authorities and filed a formal complaint. Sadly, I cannot recommend this restaurant.

CHIYODASUSHI
Dear Christopher A,

Thank you for your feedback. We are concerned to hear about your experience, as the well-being of our guests is our top priority.

At Chiyoda Sushi, we strictly adhere to rigorous food safety and quality standards. We are conducting an internal review of our kitchen logs and protocols for the day of your visit to ensure our high standards were met.

To help us investigate further, please share your visit details and a copy of your receipt with us via Direct Message on TripAdvisor. We would appreciate the opportunity to address your concerns directly.

Best regards,

This is a Good Japanese Restaurant
Jul 2025 • Couples
We weren’t totally sure about Chiyoda Sushi after reading some mixed reviews, but it was close to our hotel and the weather wasn’t very good. We have been in Vietnam for a couple of months and eaten in a few Japanese restaurants and some were probably as good as Chiyoda but not any better, the food was good the pricing and meal sizes were on point and because I was having trouble selecting which meals to eat I brought too much. They packaged the leftovers expertly with extra condiments.

The best sushi in town!
Feb 2024 • Family
I happened to visit the restaurant with my family. The first impression was that the restaurant was very beautiful and luxurious, with a private room in Japanese style. At first I thought the price would be very expensive, but I didn't expect the sushi to be very affordable, the food was very fresh and delicious, and the service style was extremely cute and enthusiastic. From now on, I will come here every time I eat sushi and will definitely recommend it to everyone.

Very delicious and special Sushi
Jan 2022
Chiyoda Shushi is a famous shushi restaurant in the Ho Chi Minh City. It's well know for its unique and distinctive style of shushi that is served with a side dish called Shushi.
The restaurant offfers an entensive menu, but it's best to start off with their specialty shushi.
Me and my friends had the opportunity to visit the restaurant at the end of january. No when the place is very cozy, the staff is friendly. Food comes up fast. We will visit again if we have the opportunity to return to Ho Chi Minh Cty.

Some dishes were good, but the tempura veg was really dull
May 2022
i like the ambience here. I've been two or three times in the last couple of months. this time I was disappointed with the tempura veg dish. Was very bland, especially the taro/sweet potato one. Well cooked, but tasteless.

The salmon sashimi was delicious, with a slightly smoky taste. 

The mixed platter of sushi was average. I don't remember any of the individual sushi 'popping' with particular flavour.

Service was good.
